records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: I wonder where Hendrik is now...
records.zh: 不知道 Hendrik 现在在哪儿……

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: It's a warzone in here, everyone fighting over ice!
records.raw: §fIt's a warzone in here, everyone fighting over ice!
records.zh: 这里简直是战场,大家都在抢冰!

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: I think we got demoted for some reason...
records.raw: §fI think we got demoted for some reason...
records.zh: 不知怎么的,我们好像被降职了……

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: There always seems to be gifts and other items in these walls!
records.raw: §fThere always seems to be gifts and other items in these walls!
records.zh: 这些冰墙里总能找到礼物和别的东西!

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: The volcano really seems to bring out more treasure in these walls.
records.raw: §fThe volcano really seems to bring out more treasure in these walls.
records.zh: 火山一活动,冰墙里的宝贝好像就更多了。

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: Do you think they'd let me bring snowballs in here?
records.raw: §fDo you think they'd let me bring snowballs in here?
records.zh: 你说,他们会让我把雪球带进来吗?

records.context: 冰川洞穴五位居民共用闲聊;同句只维护一份
records.text: I heard theres bioluminescent creatures living in this ice! It's Amazing!
records.raw: §fI heard theres bioluminescent creatures living in this ice! It's Amazing!
records.zh: 听说这冰里住着会发光的生物! 太神奇了!
